description: This file defines the EntityBatchIterator class, which implements an iterator to fetch batches of GenericValue objects from an EntityQuery, handling pagination with offset and limit.

classes.name: EntityBatchIterator
classes.description: An iterator for retrieving batches of GenericValue objects from an EntityQuery, supporting pagination and exception handling.

methods.name: EntityBatchIterator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the iterator with an EntityQuery, setting default limit and offset if not provided.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more elements to iterate over, handling exceptions internally.

methods.name: hasNextWithException
methods.description: Checks if there are more elements, fetching the next batch if needed, and may throw a GenericEntityException.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next GenericValue in the iteration, handling exceptions internally.

methods.name: nextWithException
methods.description: Returns the next GenericValue, may throw a GenericEntityException.

methods.name: getNextBatch
methods.description: Fetches the next batch of results from the query, updating the current result set and offset.

methods.name: needNextBatch
methods.description: Determines if a new batch needs to be fetched based on current position and result set.
